hero.title: The Swiss franc,|on-chain.
hero.subtitle: Frankencoin is the largest decentralized Swiss franc stablecoin. Save at the protocol rate, borrow against your assets, or build with it. No issuer, no bank: every franc is backed by collateral you can see.

buy.label: Buy ZCHF by bank transfer, 0% fees

trust: Legal opinions under Swiss law and MiCA

products.title: One franc. Four ways to use it.

save.label: Save
save.title: Earn {rate} on Swiss francs
save.body: Deposit ZCHF in the savings module. Interest accrues every block, withdraw any time.

borrow.label: Borrow
borrow.title: Francs against BTC, ETH, gold or shares
borrow.body: Keep your exposure and mint ZCHF at fixed terms. No credit check.

invest.label: Invest
invest.title: Own a share of the system
invest.body: FCS is the protocol's equity: a claim on the reserve that collects every borrower's interest, and a vote.

pay.label: Pay
pay.title: Spend it like francs
pay.body: At Spar stores, with a GnosisPay card, or by bank transfer through a personal IBAN.

proof.title: Every franc accounted for, live.
proof.subtitle: ZCHF is over-collateralized by assets locked in public contracts. These numbers update every five minutes.
proof.coins: Backed by {n} collateral types, every one on-chain

steps.title: Borrowers mint
steps.body: Anyone locks collateral and mints ZCHF against it, paying interest upfront into the reserve.

steps.title: The market holds the peg
steps.body: Every ZCHF is backed by more than a franc of collateral. Weak positions are challenged and auctioned.

steps.title: Income is shared
steps.body: Savers are paid the protocol rate first. What remains grows the reserve that FCS holders own.

final.title: Swiss francs. On-chain. Yours.
final.subtitle: Start with any amount. No account with Frankencoin, no lock-up, your own keys.
